text:
A simple electric generator induces an electromotive force (e.m.f.).
Which modification would increase the induced e.m.f.?
A
Increase the number of turns in the coil of the generator.
B
Increase the distance between the magnetic poles.
C
Reduce the strength of the magnetic field around the coil.
D
Reverse the direction of the magnetic field.

options.label: A
options.text: Increase the number of turns in the coil of the generator.

options.label: B
options.text: Increase the distance between the magnetic poles.

options.label: C
options.text: Reduce the strength of the magnetic field around the coil.

options.label: D
options.text: Reverse the direction of the magnetic field.
